SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
Enjoying the scenery without a care in the world, 
this does feel rather nice~

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: It does...

I'm seated next to Manami as she stared out 
beyond the endless blue horizon. We're having a 
short break after lunch.

Still, I'm not entirely satisfied with what we went 
with at the end.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Are you sure that's okay with you?

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: Mhm! It's good to eat those every once in a while.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Sure, but that was just fast food.

Well, it's true that Manami doesn't have fast food on 
a regular basis, but it's supposed to be a special 
event, y'know?

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: You don't like fast food, Kyou-chan?

It's not that, it just doesn't seem like an expensive 
treat... Man, to think I got psyched after getting my 
pay... However...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: ...If you're happy, then I'm fine with it.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
I haven't had anything that good in a while. 
Kyou-chan, thanks for the meal!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: O-Oh... Let's get something more delicious next time.
Geez, why is my girlfriend so selfless.

Since we became university students, she's been 
more fashionable. She seems to be conscious of her 
outfits these days.

Even though she doesn't stand out―― She won't 
embarrass me in public, a girlfriend I'm proud of.

Well, her appearance changed, but her personality's 
still the same. That’s just how she is.

The eyes behind Manami's glasses haven't changed 
at all.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
The weather is really great today. I bet the 
laundry's almost dry now.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
Yeah.. Are you the type that does their own laundry 
at home?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Nope! I'm just saying, like in genera...

We've been dating for a year now, our relationship 
hasn't progressed much at all.

Sometimes I wonder, what does Manami think of 
me?

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: *yawn* I'm so full, I'm getting sleepyyy~

I have so much on my mind and yet, Manami was 
letting out yawns without a care in the world.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
You'll become a cow if you sleep right after eating, 
you know?

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [font_size=24]Hueh?[/font_size]

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: I'm joking...

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
But then it'd be bad if I turned into a cow~ Did 
you know? Stretching while yawning relieves 
sleepiness!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Ahh, you'll feel more alert when you stretch!

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: Yup, that's right. Just like this... Hnngh!
WHOA?!

Just when she made that big stretch, suddenly a 
strikingly larger protrusion from her chest than 
usual...?!

Without knowing my hidden desire, these have 
grown amazingly well. Thank god!

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: Hm? What's wrong?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Ah, nothing. It's nothing.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: But, just now...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: I'm telling you, I'm not looking at your boobs!!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Ah...

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: Um... Kyou-chan's... interested?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: I-Interested in?

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: Well... Um, my chest...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: No, listen to me, Manami?

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: Are you interested?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Ugh...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
W-Well that's... Being a healthy young man it’s expected 
behavior, it'll be abnormal if he isn’t interested, but look, 
I'm absolutely not thinking of anything dirty!!

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: Oh?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Ahh...

Th-This is bad, this unexpected event made me lose 
control there.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: S-Sorry.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
I'd be lying if I said I wasn't the least bit interested, 
but they say with these kinds of things, we should 
take it step by step.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
Mmhm, I understand, since Kyou-chan cares a lot 
about me, right?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: What are you even saying...

I feel like I just destroyed a hard-earned flag 
somehow.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: Ehehe, I'm kind of happy about it~

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Yeah, but we can’t go on like this.

I mean, if we're stuck in our old ways of acting like 
childhood friends, we'll never really become 
“lovers” in the full sense of the word, would we?

We have to progress further in our relationship 
during the summer holidays somehow.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: *yawn* Looks like I'm getting sleepy as well...

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: Ah, in that case...

Upon hearing that, she lightly patted her lap and 
extended her arms.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: H-Here you go...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Eh?
Hah?! Is that what people call a lap pillow?!

Nonono, I'm not going to understand that with such 
a pose!

Wait a minute. Didn't she try this a really long time 
ago too...
So that's what she meant back then!

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
As a token of gratitude for your treat today. I 
guess...

She was waiting for me with a shy smile and arms 
wide open.

W-Well, no reason to reject Manami’s offer, I mean, 
isn’t this lap pillow a common thing between lovers?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: C-Can I?

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [font_size=19]Go... Go ahead.[/font_size]

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Th-Then, I'll help myself...

With slight hesitation, I plopped my head onto 
Manami's lap, stretching out into a sleeping position.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [font_size=26]Hueh...[/font_size]

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: S-Something wrong?

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
Ah, nothing. I was just a bit surprised. Your head's 
quite heavy, isn't it?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: S-Sorry. Let's just stop?

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: Ah, no need... Um, how does it feel, Kyou-chan?
It's so soft... And beyond that.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: It's kind of fragrant...

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: O-Oh, really?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Yeah, it's relaxing.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: Th-Thanks.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: ...Can I sniff more?

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [font_size=26]Ehh?![/font_size]
I just said something really embarrassing...

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: Ehh~? What are you saying?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Right now, I just really REALLY want to smell you!

Like this, if she opens up her lap a bit more, I'll be 
able to see everything! I mean, LET ME SEE!

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: S-Stop that~

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Ahaha, I'm joking, just joking!

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: A-Are you sure...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: C-Can I stay like this for a while?

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: Okay.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: M-My bad. Gonna stay like this for a little.

It feels so good, for Manami to be stroking my head 
like this...

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: Good night~

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: ...-u-chan, Kyou-chan.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: Kyou-chan, are you awake?

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: You'll catch a cold at this rate, you know?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [font_size=28]Uwaa?![/font_size]

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: I-I'm sorry! I just dozed off and...

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: Mhm~ You looked like you enjoyed yourself.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
The sun's setting. I was planning to walk around a 
bit more...

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
Oh, you had somewhere you wanted to go? Sorry 
for not waking you up.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
No, it's fine. I bet you're bored by now? You've 
been sitting in this position for a long time, haven't 
you?

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: Eh, not at all.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
I was watching the sun setting, and I even got to 
see Kyou-chan's sleeping face, I had fun as well, 
okay?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: I see.

That's right. Manami can always find fun in anything 
she sees and keep smiling.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
Now if only we had some rice crackers and green 
tea, it would be perfect~

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: No, that's just asking for too much.

As expected of Manami, being elderly-like has its 
limits too, especially with that speech.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
But, it'll get cold after the sunset. It'd be terrible if 
we caught a cold.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: That’s true. Shall we go home?

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: Okay... Yup, let's have another date some time.
